newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares off highs for '97, led by banks.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares off highs for '97, led by banks.

text.p: 1612 GMT - Portuguese shares ended stronger, and several hit or came close to highs for the year. Portuguese banking stocks Banco Comercial Portugues, Banco Espirito Santo and Banco Portugues de Investimento hit highs for 1997, boosted by optimism over results. Portugal Telecom rose to just one escudo short of its all-time high of 7,000 escudos reached on May 5. "We are once again in a mood of euphora that is set to continue, judging by the latest U.S. economic figures," said one dealer. The positive mood abroad, a stronger dollar, prospects for good company results this year and the heavily oversubscribed sale of state utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal justify the upbeat tone of the market, dealers said.
